entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Nostra Signora di Guadalupe e San Filippo Martire in Via Aurelia is the national church of Mexico in Rome. Opened in 1958, it was established as a titular church by Pope John Paul II in 1991, with Juan Jesús Posadas Ocampo as its first titular Cardinal Priest (1991–1993). It is owned and served by the Legion of Christ.
